summary: The canteen has an overall rating of 2.46 out of 5, based on 112 aspect mentions. Waiting time is a major concern, with 89% of mentions being negative. Quantity and price are also significant issues, with 80% and 75% of mentions being negative, respectively. Food quality and staff behavior are less negative, but still often criticized, with 50% and 57% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The classrooms received an overall rating of 2.62 out of 5 from student feedback. Noise was the biggest concern, with 73% of mentions being negative. Cleanliness and lighting were also major issues, with 64% of mentions being negative for both. Seating and ac/temperature received less negative feedback, but still had significant criticism, with 46% and 48% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The hostel mess has an overall rating of 2.32 out of 5. The biggest concerns raised by students are the lack of variety, with 89% of mentions being negative, and insufficient quantity, with 86% of mentions being negative. Waiting time is also a significant issue, with 83% of mentions being negative. In contrast, staff behavior has few complaints, with only 33% of mentions being negative, and price is less negative than other areas, but still often criticised, with 43% of mentions being negative.

The hostel rooms received an overall rating of 2.21 out of 5 from student feedback. Noise, maintenance and water supply were the biggest concerns, with 100%, 88% and 73% of mentions being negative, respectively. Electricity and cleanliness were less negative than these areas, but still often criticised, with 50% and 53% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The labs received an overall rating of 2.87 out of 5 from student feedback. Equipment condition was a major concern, with 75% of mentions being negative. Lab timings and software availability were also frequently criticized, with 59% and 54% of mentions being negative, respectively. In contrast, space and lab staff received relatively few complaints, with 14% and 36% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The library received an overall rating of 2.53 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were with the air conditioning/temperature, with 73% of mentions being negative, and the opening hours, with 71% of mentions being negative. The library also struggled with book availability, with 70% of mentions being negative. In contrast, digital resources received relatively few complaints, with only 22% of mentions being negative, while staff behavior was less negative than other areas but still often criticized, with 46% of mentions being negative.

The transport facility received an overall rating of 2.5 out of 5 from student feedback. The biggest concerns were crowding, with 88% of mentions being negative, and bus condition, with 69% of mentions being negative. Safety was also a significant issue, with 62% of mentions being negative. Driver behavior and fare were less negative than these areas, but still often criticized, with 41% and 57% of mentions being negative, respectively.

The wifi has an overall rating of 2.36 out of 5 from 115 aspect mentions. The biggest concerns among students are login issues, with 76% of mentions being negative, followed by reliability with 73% negative mentions, and bandwidth limit with 69% negative mentions. Coverage and connectivity also receive criticism, with 42% and 61% of mentions being negative, respectively, though less so than the biggest concerns.
